css: #__cursor, #view > :not(canvas), #status { display: none !important } body::after { content: '\2713  official'; position: fixed; right: 16px; bottom: 16px; z-index: 99; padding: 10px 22px 12px; border-radius: 40px; background: rgba(15,17,22,.78); border: 3px solid #2dd4bf; font: 800 40px/1 system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; color: #fff; pointer-events: none }

steps.js: const { S } = app, cen = S.G.cen, near = (P, lab) => { let best = -1, bd = Infinity; for (let f = 0; f < S.nF; f++) { if (lab != null && S.labels[f] !== lab) continue; const d = (cen[3*f]-P[0])**2 + (cen[3*f+1]-P[1])**2 + (cen[3*f+2]-P[2])**2; if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = f; } } return best; }; document.getElementById('fillAng').value = 15; S.active = 11; app.fillFrom(near([42, -1.5, 71])); app.fillFrom(near([46, -1.5, 71], 1)); S.active = 0; app.afterEdit('')

const { S } = app, V = app.camera.position.constructor, M4 = app.camera.matrix.constructor; S.parts.forEach((p) => (p.seeds = [])); app.afterEdit(''); const b = S.G.bbox, C = new V((b[0]+b[3])/2, (b[1]+b[4])/2, (b[2]+b[5])/2); const about = (J, n, a) => new M4().makeTranslation(J.x, J.y, J.z).multiply(new M4().makeRotationAxis(n, a)).multiply(new M4().makeTranslation(-J.x, -J.y, -J.z)); const hj = app.jointFrame(4), aj = app.jointFrame(3), bj = app.jointFrame(7); window.__icon = { explode(t) { for (let i = 1; i < S.parts.length; i++) { const x = app.ensureXf(i); x.t = x.c.map((v, k) => +((v - C.getComponent(k)) * (k < 2 ? 0.45 : 0.18) * t).toFixed(4)); } app.applyXf(); }, spin(t) { if (t < 1) S.parts[4].heal = { r: 8 }; else delete S.parts[4].heal; app.setXfMatrix(4, about(hj.J, hj.n, 2 * Math.PI * t)); app.xfEdited(4); app.applyXf(); }, swing(t) { const n = bj.J.clone().sub(aj.J).normalize(); app.setXfMatrix(3, about(aj.J, n, 35 * Math.PI / 180 * t)); app.xfEdited(3); app.applyXf(); }, };
